question.text: Exchange-Traded Currency Derivatives (ETCD) in India are traded in which segment of stock exchanges?

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 127 and 129 of the NISM Series I Currency Derivatives workbook (December 2025) state that Exchange-Traded Currency Derivatives are traded in a dedicated segment of the stock exchanges known as the Currency Derivatives Segment (CDS), with separate membership and segment-specific approvals. The Trap: ETCD are not traded in the Equity Derivatives Segment, the Cash Market Segment, or the Commodity Derivatives Segment; each segment is organised by the type of underlying asset. Note: The claim that MCX/NCDEX handle commodity derivatives is not found in the pages checked (127, 129) and is not used here.
